ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Aalto University awards scholarships to non-EU/EEA master's applicants automatically as part of the admission application — no separate form. Awards cover 50% or 100% of tuition, and the best-ranked admitted students receive the Aalto Honorary Scholarship worth EUR 5,000 on top of a full waiver. The master's application window typically runs from December to mid-January.

Programme Highlights

  • Automatic scholarship consideration with admission — no extra form
  • 50% or 100% tuition coverage, plus the EUR 5,000 Honorary Scholarship
  • One of Europe's top design-, business- and tech-focused universities
  • December-to-January application rhythm for September intake

Who Should Apply

Non-EU/EEA applicants to Aalto's English-taught master's programmes, ranked on academic merit within each programme.

Funding and Costs

Aalto scholarships cover 50% or 100% of tuition; the Aalto Honorary Scholarship adds a EUR 5,000 grant for top-ranked admitted students. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit your study application through Studyinfo during the winter window; the scholarship decision arrives with the admission result. Key deadline information: Scholarship is assessed with the master's admission application; window typically December – mid-January.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Aalto University

Aalto University combines technology, business, art and design on one campus in Espoo, Finland, and funds international master's students through automatic tuition scholarships.

Official website: https://www.aalto.fi

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: With admission application - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
